name: Lala
source:
A Mechanical Girl (Embryo) who was given life by the Ether Drive implanted within her. She acts as a bodyguard for Theofrad himself, or anyone he designates as a VIP. As her efficiency is extremely poor, she will often enter sleep mode once she runs out of energy. She is often single-mindedly focused on her assigned mission, and is somewhat lacking in terms of common sense.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
